notes: Positive: explicit Mermaid requests, named diagram types (flowchart / sequence / ER / state / class / C4 / journey / Gantt / mindmap / timeline / sankey / quadrant / architecture / gitGraph), 'create a diagram' / 'visualize' / 'draw' phrasings in any language. Negative: architecture design decisions (architect agent), code-analysis-to-derive-a-diagram (Explore first), high-fidelity UI mockups (Figma), full UML deployment diagrams (PlantUML). Edge: requests where Mermaid is suboptimal — skill should still trigger and recommend the alternative.
